faq_heading: New Listings This Week in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: How many homes sold in Surrey last month?
faq.a: In October 2026, 113 detached homes and 146 condos and townhomes sold in Surrey (SnapStats).

faq.q: How many months of supply does Surrey have?
faq.a: About 9.1 months for detached homes and 9.8 months for condos and townhomes in October 2026, measured as homes for sale divided by homes sold in the month.

faq.q: What was the busiest month for Surrey home sales this past year?
faq.a: For detached homes it was October 2026, with 113 sales; the quietest was January 2026, with 41.

faq.q: Which Surrey price range sells fastest?
faq.a: For detached homes, $900,001 to $1,000,000, with a 27% sales ratio on 12 sales in October 2026.

blocks.text: New listings in Surrey come on the MLS® every day. This search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less, live. To judge a fresh listing, it helps to know how quickly the market is clearing: in October 2026, 113 detached homes and 146 condos and townhomes sold in Surrey, and the typical detached home sold in 44 days.
How fast Surrey homes sold over the past year

Detached sales in Surrey peaked at 113 in October 2026 and were lowest at 41 in January 2026. Active detached listings moved between 808 and 1167 over the same 13 months. In October 2026 the median detached sale price was $1,248,000, which is 13% below October 2025.

blocks.text: How long a new Surrey listing may sit

Months of supply is the number of months it would take to sell today's listings at the current pace. For Surrey detached homes it was 9.1 months in October 2026 and for condos and townhomes 9.8. The fastest detached price ranges were $900,001 to $1,000,000 (27% sales ratio on 12 sales); $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 (19% sales ratio on 38 sales); $1,250,001 to $1,500,000 (10% sales ratio on 29 sales). For condos and townhomes the quickest were $900,001 to $1,000,000 (16%) and $300,001 to $400,000 (14%).

By area, new detached listings met the strongest demand in Cedar Hills (27%), Sullivan Station (20%), East Newton (15%). The areas with the most stock relative to sales were Queen Mary Park (3%), Bolivar Heights (4%), Whalley (5%), so a fresh listing there is likely to have company.

Compared with October 2025, October 2026 had 11% fewer detached homes for sale in Surrey and 22% more detached sales. Condos and townhomes had 8% fewer for sale and 25% fewer sales. The detached sale price moved 13% down and the condo and townhome price 6% down.
